title: Aligned With You
about: A song about aligning energy with the right romantic partner.
description: Instead of focusing on finding a specific person, this song centers on becoming aligned with the type of relationship that naturally fits. It reflects the belief that the right partnership comes from compatibility in mindset and direction.
lyrics: Verse 1
I am aligned with my ideal partner
Not searching, not forcing, just aligning
I am aligned with meeting my ideal partner
Love moving quietly, not hiding
I attract emotionally available partners
Healthy, loving opportunities
I attract someone open and real
Someone who feels what I feel
Pre-Chorus
I attract a partner who truly values me
Someone who respects what she sees
I draw in a partner who chooses me
Not almost, not later, but me
Chorus
I attract love that feels safe and natural
I attract sincere romantic connection
I attract mutual attraction and genuine interest
Something steady, something intentional
I attract a partner who’s ready for real love
Ready to build something real
I attract genuine, lasting love
I attract what I’m meant to feel
Verse 2
I attract someone excited to meet me
I attract someone emotionally open
I attract a partner who wants commitment
A heart that’s real, not broken
I attract a partner who fits my life
I attract a partner who sees my worth
I attract a partner who aligns with my values
The kind of love that works
Pre-Chorus 2
I attract love that enters effortlessly
I attract love that is stable and healthy
I attract a relationship built on trust
Something solid, something steady
Chorus
I attract love that feels safe and natural
I attract sincere romantic connection
I attract mutual attraction and genuine interest
Something steady, something intentional
I attract a partner who’s ready for real love
Ready to build something real
I attract genuine, lasting love
I attract what I’m meant to feel
Bridge
My significant other and I
Are naturally drawn to each other
Before the names, before the faces
There’s already a pull between us
I attract romantic connections that grow easily
Not rushed, not forced, just true
I am aligned with a stable, loyal kind of love
And it’s moving me closer to you
Final Chorus
I attract love that feels safe and natural
I attract sincere romantic connection
I attract mutual attraction and genuine interest
A love that moves in my direction
I attract a partner who’s ready for real love
I attract a partner who truly values me
I attract genuine, lasting love
And it’s finding its way to me
